sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>global.informUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><name>informUtils</name><script><![CDATA[var informUtils = Class.create();
informUtils.prototype = {
	
	initialize : function() {
	},
	
	insertRule : function(current, name, order, script) {
		var gr = new GlideRecord("sys_script");
		gr.initialize();
		gr.setValue("name", name);
		gr.setValue("collection", current.getValue("table"));
		gr.setValue("order", order);
		gr.setValue("when", "async_always");
		gr.setValue("action_insert", true);
		gr.setValue("action_update", true);
		gr.setValue("script", script);
		gr.setValue("sys_scope", gs.getProperty("x_75740_inform.application_id"));
		gr.insert();
		return gr.getValue("sys_id");
	},
	
	deleteRule : function(current) {
		var gr = new GlideRecord("sys_script");
		gr.addEncodedQuery("sys_id=" + current.getValue("rule_for_generating_file"));
		gr.query();
		if(gr.next()) {
			gr.deleteRecord();
		}
	},
	
	insertSchedule : function(current, name, script) {
		var gr = new GlideRecord("sysauto_script");
		gr.initialize();
		gr.setValue("name", name);
		gr.setValue("sys_scope", gs.getProperty("x_75740_inform.application_id"));
		gr.setValue("run_type", current.getValue("run"));
		gr.setValue("run_time", current.getValue("time"));
		gr.setValue("script", script);
		gr.insert();
		return gr.getValue("sys_id");
	},
	
	deleteSchedule : function(current) {
		var gr = new GlideRecord("sysauto_script");
		gr.addEncodedQuery("sys_id=" + current.getValue("rule_for_scheduled_execution"));
		gr.query();
		if(gr.next()) {
			gr.deleteRecord();
		}
	},
	
	createZIP : function(template, current, fileName) {		
		var encData = "";
		var attachments = new GlideRecord("sys_attachment");
		attachments.addEncodedQuery("table_sys_id=" + current.getValue("sys_id"));
		attachments.query();
		while(attachments.next()) {
			var sa = new GlideSysAttachment();
			var binData = sa.getBytes(attachments);
			var zipBinData = this._addBytesToZip(attachments.file_name, binData);
			encData = GlideStringUtil.base64Encode(zipBinData);
		}
		
		var gsa = new GlideSysAttachment();
		var result = gsa.write(current, fileName, "application/zip", zipBinData);
		return result;
	},
	
	_addBytesToZip : function(fileName, stream) {
		var outStream = Packages.java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream();
		var out = new Packages.java.util.zip.ZipOutputStream(outStream);
		out.putNextEntry(new Packages.java.util.zip.ZipEntry(fileName));
		out.write(stream, 0, stream.length);
		out.closeEntry();
		out.close();
		return outStream.toByteArray();
	},
	
	type : 'informUtils'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2023-03-16 11:12:45</sys_created_on><sys_id>886fc7222f2de510d12470682799b626</sys_id><sys_mod_count>15</sys_mod_count><sys_name>informUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_886fc7222f2de510d12470682799b626</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2023-03-16 15:17:29</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
